name: -8 AN to 3/8" NPT 90 Degree Elbow Adapter
title: -8 AN to 3/8" NPT 90 Degree Elbow Adapter
description:
The -8 AN to 3/8" NPT 90 Degree Elbow Adapter is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN to NPT 90 Degree Elbow Adapter Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to NPT ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, and power steering plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
• Thread Pitch: Precision NPT tapered threads for leak-free sealing in blocks and cells.
